messages.subject: missing species after enforcing symmetry
parts:
I lost one species after running bilat.symmetry. Code is below. Any ideas what might be the issue?

Thank you,
Nick

> dim(Y.gpa$coords)
[1]  79   3 333

# bilateral symmetry
Y.sym=bilat.symmetry(Y.gpa$coords, ind = species, object.sym = TRUE, land.pairs = land.pairs, RRPP = TRUE, iter = 999, print.progress = TRUE)

> dim(Y.sym$symm.shape)
[1]  79   3 332

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] missing species after enforcing symmetry
parts:
Nick,

check for duplicates in your species ids, or for a species missing the repetitions (I assume you have digitized 2x?). One of these might be the reason.

Antigoni
